snippet.title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Seaforge is an open-world survival craft game where you play as an explorer shipwrecked in Atlantis. Build your home base on sunlit shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover lost Atlantean technology. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey! Coming soon to PC.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4712440/Seaforge_Shores_of_Atlantis/
